content.value: Design a pile cap for a column 20 inch square exerting a load of 300000 Ib. Each pile has the bearing capacity of 85000 Ib and 20 inch in diameters. Take the usual stresses $f _ { s } = 2 4 0 0 0$ psi and $f _ { c } ^ { \prime } = 3 5 0 0$ psi. Show the reinforcement detailing.
